items.title: The hubris of LAC is astounding.
items.author: Basketball Poetry
items.body_excerpt:
The hubris of LAC is astounding. 

The NBA would've been thrilled if Clips had said "hey, we admit no purposeful wrongdoing, but understand we made a mistake. Let's settle by forfeiting two firsts."

Instead, they thumbed their nose and dared Adam Silver to do something. 

And Adam Silver did.
